Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FnGN62GnrQjMxKygtv3KUn

* test(invitations): real-DB integration for [id]/resend/accept routes

26 tests across GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/invitations/[id],
POST /api/invitations/[id]/resend, and GET/POST /api/invitations/accept.
Pins the IDOR gap (purses-nj7): [id] routes have no ownership/membership
check — any authed user can mutate any invitation. Also pins that POST
accept flips status but does NOT create a membership row (stub TODO).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FnGN62GnrQjMxKygtv3KUn

* test(routes): real-DB integration for shared-results + users/me

15 tests across GET /api/shared-results/[token] (public, no-auth verified)
and GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/users/me (session-gated, self-only). Pins the
soft-delete gap: DELETE /me sets emailVerified=null, row survives.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FnGN62GnrQjMxKygtv3KUn

* test(routes): real-DB integration for members + archive/restore lifecycle

26 tests across GET/POST /collections/[id]/members, POST /archive,
POST /restore (collection), POST /items/[id]/restore. Happy path asserts
real DB-state transitions; full 401/403/404 matrix per route. Pins three
authz gaps without fixing them: purses-55c (GET members no membership
check), missing-404 on archive/restore (canManageCollection returns false
not 404 for absent collection), purses-3al (item restore IDOR — no tenant
check).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FnGN62GnrQjMxKygtv3KUn

* test(routes): real-DB integration for preferences items + recalculate

11 tests across GET /api/collections/[id]/preferences/items and POST
/api/collections/[id]/preferences/recalculate: 401 unauthenticated, happy
path with real pref rows, empty-caller case, absent-collection (pins current
200+[] behavior), stranger/non-member (pins 200+[] auth gap), recalc creates
rows from triage decisions, idempotent update path, no-decision no-op, absent
collection, and curator-id scoping across two members. AUTH GAPs (pv9): both
routes lack a membership/existence guard — pinned, not fixed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FnGN62GnrQjMxKygtv3KUn

* test(routes): real-DB integration for signup + collections + items core routes
